description:
Code that hard-codes development-artifact paths turns every relocation into a breaking change. The owner-approved invariant `no-dev-path-coupling` makes that coupling a reviewable defect.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The invariant registry holds `no-dev-path-coupling` with exactly this statement: "Production code, tooling, tests, receipts, and harness crates locate development artifacts by content identity or through one configured repository root resolved at runtime; hard-coded `dev/` paths, historical-path allow-lists, and depth-dependent relative paths are a defect."
- [hard] REQ-02: The invariant records the code-review gate (`@/gate/code-review`) as its enforcer.
- [hard] REQ-03: The invariant projection region of the root `AGENTS.md` is regenerated deterministically, content outside the region is byte-identical, and `AGENTS.md` stays at or below 200 lines.
- [hard] REQ-04: Invariant checks and tracker validation report no new findings.
title: Register and project the no-dev-path-coupling invariant
